core_obligations: Recall the short exact sequence 0 -> O_X -> O_X(D) -> i_*i^*O_X(D) -> 0 attached to the effective Cartier divisor D with closed immersion i : D -> X (proof lines 9854-9860).
Tensor the sequence by the locally free module E, so that exactness is preserved and one obtains 0 -> E -> E(D) -> i_*i^*E(D) -> 0 (proof lines 9861-9865).
Apply additivity of the Euler characteristic and the finite-support lemma to derive the two stated formulas (proof lines 9866-9869).
Record that D is finite over Spec(k) of degree equal to dim_k Gamma(D, O_D), as asserted in the first sentence of the lemma.
proof_roadmap: Use the defining exact sequence of an effective Cartier divisor.
Tensor by the locally free module to get the shifted sequence.
Apply additivity of the Euler characteristic and finite support.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the degree of an effective Cartier divisor D on a proper scheme of dimension at most one as the dimension of its global sections, and shows that twisting a locally free module of rank n by O_X(D) shifts the degree by n deg(D). The proof uses the definition of an effective Cartier divisor to write the short exact sequence 0 -> O_X -> O_X(D) -> i_*i^*O_X(D) -> 0 for the closed immersion i : D -> X, tensors it by the locally free module E so that exactness is preserved, and then applies additivity of the Euler characteristic together with the finite-support lemma to obtain the degree formula (proof lines 9845-9869). H2: the exact-sequence computation together with the two cited inputs is the substance, and the argument is written out.
